aggregate.priority_note: Counts are measured from the paired data. Impact weights are explicit heuristics, not learned probabilities. Specialized findings such as LaTeX command errors can overlap with character-level counts.
aggregate.classification_note: Glyph and operator labels use explicit visual/symbol equivalence rules; their frequencies are measured from this alignment, not assumed in advance.

confidence_analysis.note: Confidence matching uses the closest OCR text span and should be audited for calibration.
